info.name: Mabdel AI (GoCustify) - Complete API Collection (Page-wise)
info.description:
# Mabdel AI / GoCustify Platform API Collection

Comprehensive Postman collection containing **100% of all platform endpoints** organized page-wise and module-wise.

### Included Pages & Modules:
- 01. Authentication & Onboarding Wizard
- 02. Dashboard, Home & Analytics
- 03. Unified Inbox & Conversations (SMS, Email, WhatsApp, Real-time WebSockets)
- 04. Calls & Voice AI (Receptionist Realtime Audio Stream & Settings)
- 05. Contacts & Audience Groups
- 06. Calendar, Appointments & Booking
- 07. Bulk Messaging & SMS Campaigns
- 08. Documents, Agreements & Lease Contracts
- 09. AI Automations & SmartFlow Workflows
- 10. Integrations (WhatsApp, Meta, Telegram, Telnyx Telephony, Stripe Connect)
- 11. Business Profile, Custom Email Domain & Settings
- 12. Billing, Invoices & Add-on Shop
- 13. Support Tickets & Social Media
- 14. Admin & Owner Dashboard (RBAC, Team, Demos, Super Admin)
- 15. Public Website & Legal Content
- 16. Webhooks & System Health Checks

### Environment Variables:
- `baseUrl`: Base URL of the API (Default: `http://localhost:8000`)
- `authToken`: JWT access token for authenticated requests
- `adminToken`: Admin / Superadmin JWT access token

request.description:
Single Call Control webhook — Telnyx posts every voice event here, tagged by
``event_type`` (call.initiated, call.answered, call.hangup, streaming.started, ...).
This also covers browser (WebRTC) calls now: On-Demand Credentials share this same
webhook, so there's no separate client-reported "session sync" endpoint anymore —
call_logs update from this one authoritative source for every call, phone or browser.

Also mounted, unprefixed, at ``/webhooks/telnyx/voice`` (see
``app.api.telnyx_webhook_alias``) to match the URL already registered on the
Telnyx Voice Application — TELNYX_WEBHOOK_URL in .env — so switching this over
doesn't require re-registering the webhook in the Telnyx portal.

User action on a live call (receive, transfer_to_ai, cancel).

``call_sid`` here is the Telnyx ``call_control_id``.
Secured by JWT authentication.

Returns the live transcript of an AI-handled call by provider call ID.
Polled by the mobile app during an active AI call session.

Meetings the AI phone agent proposed to a caller, awaiting a team member's
approval — the AI never books these on its own.
Receive live audio chunks, send AI audio reply.

The business's AI phone persona — assistant name, voice, custom greetings,
extra instructions and the keypad language menu. Org-wide, like business hours.

Starts a new simulated call: a fresh AIPhoneAgent (is_simulation=True) loaded
with this organization's real ai_call_settings/business_profiles, so the preview
behaves exactly like a real inbound call would. Returns the greeting text the AI
would open with — composed the same way a real call's greeting is (see
AIPhoneAgent._compose_greeting_text), just without any audio synthesis.
Ends (or resets) a test conversation — drops the held AIPhoneAgent instance.

Feeds the caller's simulated text straight into the same
AIPhoneAgent._advance_conversation the real call websocket handler drives — no
mock/fake conversation logic, so the preview is representative. Returns the AI's
reply text plus whether the simulated call would now hang up (should_hangup),
e.g. after a booking is confirmed and the business's closing_message is spoken.

The organization's business hours — the window the AI phone agent offers
caller meeting slots from. Shared org-wide, not per-user.

Which calendar provider (Google / Apple / Zoom) is the primary two-way sync
target, which providers are connected, and — for connected-but-not-primary
providers — whether they're still usable purely to mint real meeting links.

The page behind the "View meeting details" link in a meeting invite. Shows only what
    the invite itself already says: title, when, where and the join link.

Starts a brand-new AI chat — the "New Chat" button. Backs a ChatGPT-style
sidebar: each call creates a separate conversation the sidebar can list and
switch between, instead of every message landing in one single lifelong thread.

Separated out from /ai/chat's response_mode='both' so callers (the voice
conversation UI) can show the text reply the moment it's ready instead of
blocking on TTS synthesis too — the two are sequential server-side (audio is
generated from the finished text) and TTS alone typically adds 1-3+ seconds.

Telnyx messaging webhook (set it as the Messaging Profile's webhook URL): inbound
SMS to a business's number, and delivery receipts for replies sent from Unified.
Signed with the same Telnyx key as the call webhooks.

Creates (if needed) the organization's Stripe Express account and returns a
fresh Stripe-hosted onboarding link to finish/resume KYC.

Returns the organization's Stripe Connect onboarding status — one connected
account per business, shared by the whole team's invoices.
Removes the organization's custom Telnyx credentials.
Saves the organization's own Telnyx API key after validating it with a live API call.

Orders a Telnyx voice-enabled number for the organization and attaches it to the
platform's Call Control Application. Runs synchronously (in a thread pool) and
returns once the order settles. One number per business — every team member with
calls:manage (owner + manager by default) shares it.
Releases the organization's Telnyx phone number.

Returns the organization's Telnyx provisioning status and phone number —
one number per business, shared by the whole team.

The gateway forwards the names/numbers the linked phone knows (history sync and
contact updates), so threads show real names instead of "WhatsApp Contact".

The gateway calls this once a freshly linked session syncs the phone's existing
chat history (Baileys' messaging-history.set), so old messages land in Unified too,
not just new ones. Same per-organization secret as the live webhook; whatsapp's
resolve/validate already match on the secret alone, no per-message field needed.
